_comment: Bundled-content / approved-target registry for the Command Center update paths. This file states which installed roots this repository actually ships and under what policy each update path may use a moving default branch. It carries POLICY only, never a live pin: a roll's commit arrives through CC_UPDATE_TARGET so no repository, schedule or client setting is changed by a registry edit. Unknown keys are ignored by the readers (check-updates.sh, update.sh).

install_roots.note: legacy hand-install layout, kept as last-resort fallback

update_paths.name: zero-downtime
update_paths.note: honours CC_UPDATE_TARGET today; becomes mandatory when the registry or CC_REQUIRE_APPROVED_TARGET says so

update_paths.name: merge-fallback
update_paths.note: previously converged to moving origin/main regardless of a pin

update_paths.name: check-updates
update_paths.note: previously always measured against moving main

env_override.CC_REQUIRE_APPROVED_TARGET: 1 makes an approved target mandatory on every update path, regardless of this registry
env_override.CC_UPDATE_TARGET: commit SHA of the approved target for the current roll
